item: D24 (R102): ring members are no longer hidden by another language's stoplist (34 words, per language)
summary: The cross-language ring kills that tests/test_ring_members_vs_global_stopwords.py ratcheted at 38 are resolved: a ring member a language spells as content (French dette hidden by the Danish grammar word, English war hidden by the German one) is lifted from the stoplist union in that language at extraction, and from the query-time union everywhere; four members whose own language's curated list holds them (fr tout and se, en work and making) stay hidden. The ratchet is now zero. Existing articles pick the words up on a re-index.
